$comment: Atlas governance policy — ADMIN-OWNED BY INTENT, versioned. WARNING, read this before trusting the file: the CODEOWNERS + branch-protection lock described in docs/governance/policy-lock.md is NOT IN FORCE and cannot be turned on under the repo's current plan (GitHub returns 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public' for branch protection and rulesets, and rejects the CODEOWNERS line as an unknown owner). Anyone with write access can therefore edit this file directly. The ONE control that IS live is the loader's fail-closed default: absent/malformed => empty scopes => NO write is authorized.

nearDup.$comment: Near-duplicate matcher threshold (feeds @atlas/knowledge NearDupConfig.claimNormThreshold). 1 = exact-match only (conservative). Lower toward ~0.85 to merge near-synonym claims once the synonym-tau is trusted.

t0Heuristic.$comment: Keywords that flag a fact as a T0 (human-ratification) candidate.

authz.$comment: Owner-scoped write (KNOW-11): scope => actor ids authorized to write it. Reads are universal regardless. An unlisted scope or actor is fail-closed (no write). Replace the placeholder seat with real actor ids.
